goals.title: Operate from a realistic daily plan
goals.description: Keep fixed commitments, available time, top outcomes, and recovery choices current.

goals.title: Keep the apartment clean, organized, and useful
Build consistent training without overloading the week
Complete structured paper-trading education
goals.description: Use one market, one setup, one risk unit, and one journal. No live-trading automation.

projects.title: Apartment operating reset
projects.outcome: Core rooms have a clear definition of done, recurring upkeep, and prioritized furnishing needs.

projects.title: Decide the second-bedroom configuration
projects.outcome: Choose a reversible room use after comparing cost, privacy, lifestyle value, effort, flexibility, and income potential.

projects.title: Houston wedding trip preparation
projects.outcome: Confirm travel dates and complete bookings, clothing, packing, documents, budget, event preparation, and return reset.

projects.title: SPY paper-trading study track
projects.outcome: Complete structured study, chart review, mock orders, replay trades, and simulator gates before any separate decision about live trading.

tasks.title: Connect and select Google Calendars
tasks.definition_of_done: Google account is connected, selected calendars are visible, and a real read sync succeeds.

tasks.title: Verify recurring work commitments after Calendar sync
tasks.definition_of_done: Fixed work events, travel buffers, and any recurring obligations are confirmed rather than assumed.

tasks.title: Plan the next laundry cycle
tasks.minimum_viable_definition: Sort and start the most-needed load; schedule transfer and fold steps separately.
tasks.definition_of_done: Needed loads are washed, dried, folded, and put away.

tasks.title: Inspect and document household humidity or moisture concern
tasks.definition_of_done: Current condition, actions taken, next check date, and any maintenance-request need are recorded.

tasks.title: Set second-bedroom decision weights
tasks.definition_of_done: Cost, income, privacy, lifestyle, effort, flexibility, and reversibility weights total 100 and assumptions are documented.

tasks.title: Confirm Houston wedding trip dates and existing bookings
tasks.definition_of_done: Departure, return, wedding date, trip timezone, lodging, transport, and confirmed reservations are entered and marked user-confirmed.

tasks.title: Inventory Houston clothing, travel essentials, and documents
tasks.minimum_viable_definition: List what is already owned and the highest-priority missing items.
tasks.definition_of_done: Owned items, missing items, purchases, outfits, and documents are recorded by category.

tasks.title: Define the first SPY paper-trading study session
tasks.definition_of_done: The session has one source, one concrete objective, one chart/practice activity, completion evidence, and next action.

routines.title: Home zone reset
routines.note: Importer should replace the temporary recurrence with user-selected zone cadence during onboarding.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desired_state: Clear surfaces, clean sink, managed dishes, swept floor, needed supplies stocked

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desired_state: Sanitized fixtures, clear counter, clean mirror, clean floor, trash removed

rooms.name: Primary Bedroom
rooms.desired_state: Bed reset, clothing contained, surfaces clear, floor accessible

rooms.name: Living Area
rooms.desired_state: Floor clear, surfaces controlled, furnishings intentionally placed

cleaning_zones.name: Kitchen reset
cleaning_zones.definition_of_done: Dishes handled, sink and priority surfaces cleaned, trash removed, and floor swept.

cleaning_zones.name: Bathroom reset
cleaning_zones.definition_of_done: Toilet, sink, mirror, and priority surfaces are cleaned; trash is removed; floor is addressed.

cleaning_zones.name: Bedroom reset
cleaning_zones.definition_of_done: Bed is reset, clothing is contained, main surfaces are clear, and walking space is open.

cleaning_zones.name: Floor and living-area reset
cleaning_zones.definition_of_done: Loose items are contained, floor is clear and cleaned, and high-use surfaces are reset.

maintenance_records.title: Humidity and moisture follow-up
maintenance_records.note: This record manages observations and follow-up only. It does not diagnose mold or structural conditions.

scheduling_constraints: Treat pain or injury constraints as blockers or reasons to reduce scope
Do not generate medical diagnosis or rehabilitation guidance

learning_sessions.objective: Identify and annotate five examples that meet the single approved setup rules.
learning_sessions.practice_activity: Review charts and record why each example qualifies or fails.
learning_sessions.completion_evidence: Five annotated charts plus one written rule clarification.
learning_sessions.next_action: Create the next mock-order practice session.
financial_firewall: No rent, bill, emergency, borrowed, or tax money
No live-trading recommendation from Mission Control

trips.name: Houston wedding trip
trips.notes: Prior date details conflict. Confirm departure, return, wedding date, lodging, and transportation before generating deadlines.
